resources.string: Please read this in full before first use. After accepting, you can reread it at the bottom of the main screen.

Output resolution can follow the head unit (percentage scaling) or use a fixed/custom size. Fixed modes ignore the percentage, and resolution and frame-rate changes apply on the next connection. CarWith may ignore the requested size; the connection log\'s VIDEO_INIT_DONE value is authoritative.
Turn the panel off while connected
After connecting, the phone panel is physically powered off (the system stays awake); when off, only dimming is used. Press the power button twice to restore the screen.

Starts a session when the head unit connects over Bluetooth (Shizuku must be running). Starting in the background needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission, which is granted automatically if missing.

For key calibration: when on, each HID report is logged as a HID-RAW line (uuid + hex bytes) so you can match steering-wheel/knob presses to key mappings. Keep it off normally to avoid flooding the log.
Fallback: try unencrypted after pairing fails

Off by default. When pairing fails (except 403) but the receiver is reachable, try one unencrypted session. Turn on only if the receiver always stalls at pairing and you know it supports only unencrypted sessions; applies on the next connection.
Fallback: try audio when no format is declared

Off by default. When the receiver declares no usable media audio format, still try the default PCM 48k. Turn on only if the car can play sound but mcarplay always sends video only; this may cause silence or a disconnect. Applies on the next connection.

While a navigation or voice prompt plays, music is lowered to this level and fades back afterwards. Drag right to lower it more; far left means no lowering. Default -15 dB. Changes apply immediately while connected.
Follow car: head-unit resolution × %1$d%%, aligned to even pixels; VIDEO_INIT_DONE remains the authoritative source size.
Fixed %1$d×%2$d: the percentage is ignored; this size is used for the stream and requested from CarWith, which may ignore it.
Custom %1$d×%2$d: limited to 320×180–1920×1080 and aligned to even pixels; CarWith may ignore the request.
Custom resolution %1$d×%2$d saved (applies on the next connection)
Width and height must be positive whole numbers
This size exceeds the H.264 level 4.0 per-frame macroblock limit
At H.264 level 4.0, %1$d×%2$d is limited to %3$d fps; choosing 60 fps encodes this connection at %3$d fps.
The %1$d×%2$d requested from CarWith is limited to %3$d fps at H.264 level 4.0, so the request rate is %3$d fps.
This size exceeds the H.264 level 4.0 per-frame limit and will be reduced to %1$d×%2$d on connection.
Percentage scaling is ignored in fixed-resolution mode
Changes while connected apply on the next connection (the encoder frame rate is fixed when the session starts); the status card shows this session\'s actual/target frame rate
Paired devices can be selected directly; tapping an unpaired device starts system Bluetooth pairing
No paired devices yet; scan below and tap one to pair

Off by default. Runs only when the home-page "Vehicle profile" is set to Volkswagen. Try one at a time. Rebuild on fail: if the car shows no touch and asks for no key frame within 3 s of taking the screen back, rebuild the screen stream once. Disconnect on fail: end the session after two such failures in a row so you can reconnect. No rebuild: tapping the icon does not rebuild the screen stream, it only re-asserts ownership and resends parameter sets. No vehicle evidence for any of them; applies from the next icon tap.
Selected: no stream rebuild on icon tap
